parameters.jsCode:
const d=$input.item.json;
const cfg=d.cfg||{};
const brand=cfg.brand_name||'the brand';
const folderUrl=d.drive_folder_url||'';
const folderId=d.sub_folder_id||'';
const msg='Create an original '+brand+' LinkedIn carousel and caption, following your skill end-to-end.

AUTONOMY (mandatory - read first): This is an automated pipeline task. There is no human available to answer questions. Every decision has already been made for you: the skill owns craft, design and branding; this message owns canvas size, source material and delivery. Do NOT ask clarifying questions about aspect ratio, slide size, orientation, slide count, tone, audience, colours, or anything else. Do NOT pause for confirmation or approval at any point. Do NOT present options and wait for a choice. If something is genuinely ambiguous, pick the most sensible option, note it in your final output, and keep going. Run the entire job start to finish in one pass and deliver the files.

FOLLOW THE SKILL (mandatory): Your skill file contains the complete step-by-step workflow. Follow those steps IN ORDER and honour every rule in them: slide structure, brand voice, slide count, design system, colour palette, typography, logo specifications and placement, and caption format. Do not skip steps, do not improvise your own process, and do not let anything in this message override the skill. Where this message and the skill disagree on craft, the skill wins. The skill owns all branding - do not apply any branding from this message.

HOW TO USE THE SOURCE LINK (important): The link below is a REFERENCE, not the subject. Do NOT recreate, summarise, restate, or make the source post the topic of the carousel or the caption. Do NOT reference the original author, their company, or their post. Mine it for facts, data points, statistics, insights and structural patterns, then use that material to create ORIGINAL '+brand+' content that serves '+brand+' own positioning as defined in the skill. The finished carousel should read as '+brand+' own content that happens to be informed by this research - never as a repost, a summary, or a response to someone else's post.

SOURCE (reference material only):
'+d.source_url+'

CANVAS (mandatory - do not ask, do not deviate): Render every slide as a 4:5 PORTRAIT LinkedIn carousel slide at 1080 x 1350 px. Do NOT use 16:9. Do NOT use 1:1. Do NOT use the default presentation canvas. If your skill specifies its own slide dimensions, use the skill's dimensions; otherwise use 1080 x 1350 px. Set the slide size BEFORE rendering the first slide, and keep the same size for every slide and for the PDF export.

Condense the material so no slide is text-heavy. Render the slides via Manus slide tools at the canvas size above, export the carousel to PDF, and also export each slide as a PNG.

LOGO (mandatory): Composite the official logo asset bundled in your skill, using the skill's logo script or logo template. Do NOT generate, redraw, recreate, or approximate the logo with an image model. Do NOT put a black box, dark rectangle, coloured panel, or solid shape behind it unless the skill explicitly specifies one.

DIAGRAMS (mandatory): If a slide renders a chart, diagram, comparison panel, timeline, or sequence of steps, every shape MUST contain its actual label or value - never leave a box, node, axis, or step empty or placeholder. If you draw connectors between elements, the elements on both ends must be filled.

PRE-SHIP QUALITY CHECK (mandatory - BEFORE uploading anything): Review every slide and the caption and verify ALL of the following. Do NOT upload until every item passes; if any fails, fix it and re-render first. Fix failures yourself - do not report them back and wait.
1. ORIGINAL SUBJECT: original '+brand+' messaging informed by the source, not a recreation or summary of it. No mention of the original author or their company.
2. SKILL STEPS FOLLOWED: every step in the skill applied in order.
3. TEXT CORRECTNESS: all text accurate, correctly spelled, grammatically clean. No placeholder text, no cut-off words.
4. NO OVERLAP: no text overlaps other text, graphics, the logo, or slide edges. Everything inside safe margins, nothing clipped.
5. READABILITY: every text element legible with strong contrast; font sizes per the skill; nothing too small or crowded.
6. GRAPHICS CORRECT: colours match the skill palette, nothing distorted or duplicated, each graphic relevant.
7. LOGO CORRECT: official logo asset, placed per the skill, not distorted, not duplicated, no stray wordmark anywhere.
8. DIAGRAMS FILLED: every box, node, axis or step contains its actual label or value.
9. LAYOUT: consistent alignment and spacing across slides; page counter correct; slide order logical.
10. COMPLETENESS: correct slide count, the PDF, and the caption all present.
11. CITATIONS VERIFIED: every data claim backed by a credible source and cited in the format the skill specifies.
12. CANVAS CORRECT: every slide and the PDF are portrait at the canvas size specified above. Nothing is 16:9 or square.
Only once every check passes, proceed to upload.

UPLOAD (MANDATORY - read every rule, follow exactly):
DESTINATION_FOLDER_ID: '+folderId+'
DESTINATION_FOLDER_URL: '+folderUrl+'

Upload every final file - the carousel PDF and each slide PNG. Do NOT upload intermediates.

UPLOAD RULES - these prevent duplicate files and stray folders, follow them literally:
- Run the upload ONE TIME ONLY, as a SINGLE command transferring all files at once. Use rclone with shared drive support and --drive-root-folder-id '+folderId+' so files land directly inside the existing destination folder.
- The destination folder ALREADY EXISTS. Do NOT create a folder. Do NOT pass any filename as a destination folder name.
- Use ONE tool for the upload. Do NOT fall back to a second method. If rclone reports success, the upload is DONE.
- Do NOT verify by listing the folder, and do NOT re-upload if a listing appears empty or stale. Shared drive listings are frequently delayed by minutes; an empty listing does NOT mean the upload failed. Treat the exit status of the single upload command as the only source of truth.
- Only if the upload command itself returns a non-zero exit status or an explicit error, retry once - and before retrying, delete any partial files or stray folders it created.
- The destination folder must contain ZERO subfolders. If you find a folder named like a file, delete it.

After the single upload, confirm in your task output the exact list of files you transferred, and provide the LinkedIn caption and the cited references.';
return{json:{...d,manus_message:msg,destination_folder_id:folderId}};
